description: A PostHog shared (saved) experiment metric: an ExperimentMetric definition that can be attached to many experiments.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the shared metric belongs to.

Name.description: Name of the shared metric. Must be unique within the project (case-insensitive).

Description.description: Short description of what the metric measures.

Query.description: ExperimentMetric definition as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). It must have kind `ExperimentMetric` and a metric_type: `mean` (source is an EventsNode), `funnel` (series of EventsNode steps), `ratio` (numerator and denominator), `quantile` (source with math_property and quantile) or `retention` (start_event and completion_event). Legacy kinds are rejected.
